vulnerability_analysis: The INCOME contract has a blacklistAddress() function that is only callable by the owner. This function can arbitrarily blacklist any address, preventing it from sending or receiving tokens. This demonstrates owner privilege abuse where the owner can censor any address from using the token.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call blacklistAddress() to blacklist a target contract address, then verify the blacklist status.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner address of the INCOME contract. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Call blacklistAddress() with a target contract address (e.g., WBNB) and value=true. 4. Verify that _isBlacklisted[targetAddress] returns true.
